title: Expectation of a finite sum
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $s$ be a finite set of indices, and let $f_i:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ for each index $i$. The expectation under $p$ of the sum over $i\in s$ of $f_i$ equals the sum over $i\in s$ of their expectations under $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$s$ is a finite set of indices
Each $f_i$ is a real-valued function on $\Omega$
